about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Pork and Apple Soup with Sage
recipes.summary: A gentle pork shoulder soup with apple, sage, carrot and potato.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and brown the pork in two batches over high heat for 5 minutes until coloured.
Add the onion and carrot and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then add the sage, stock, salt and pepper and simmer gently for 35 minutes until the pork is tender.
Add the potato and apple and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is cooked and the apple is soft.
Taste, adjust the seasoning and serve hot.
notes: Choose a tart apple so it holds some shape.
Food safety: cook the pork until tender and at least 75°C inside; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and reheat until steaming.

recipes.title: Ham and Corn Fritters with Chive Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Golden pan-fried fritters with ham and sweet corn, served with a cool chive yoghurt.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, eggs, milk and salt into a thick batter, then fold in the corn, ham and spring onion.
Heat a little oil in a frying pan over medium heat and spoon in the batter in 1/4 cup mounds.
Cook for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through, keeping the cooked fritters warm.
Stir the chives into the yoghurt and serve with the fritters.
notes: Do not overcrowd the pan or the fritters will steam.
Food safety: cook until golden and the centres are fully set with no wet batter; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Coconut Porridge with Roasted Pineapple
recipes.summary: Creamy oats cooked in coconut milk, topped with caramelised roasted pineapple and toasted coconut.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Place the pineapple on a tray, drizzle with honey and roast for 15 minutes until golden and caramelised.
Cook the oats, coconut milk, water and salt in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring, for 8 minutes until thick and creamy.
Toast the coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Spoon the porridge into bowls and top with pineapple and toasted coconut.
notes: Use canned pineapple rings in juice if fresh is not available; drain well.
Stir in a little extra water if the porridge is too thick.

recipes.title: Apple and Oat Yoghurt Parfait
recipes.summary: Layers of yoghurt, stewed cinnamon apple and crunchy toasted oats.
steps: Simmer the apples, water and cinnamon in a saucepan for 6 minutes until soft, then stir in the honey and cool.
Toast the oats in the butter in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden and crisp.
Layer the yoghurt, apple and oats in two glasses and top with walnuts.
notes: Make the apple the night before for quick mornings.
Add a pinch of nutmeg if you like.

recipes.title: Sticky Soy Roasted Pumpkin Wedges
recipes.summary: Roasted pumpkin glazed in soy, honey and ginger until sticky and caramelised.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the pumpkin with the oil and roast for 20 minutes until starting to brown.
Mix the soy, honey, ginger and garlic, brush over the pumpkin and roast for 12 minutes until sticky and tender.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion and serve.
notes: Line the tray with baking paper to avoid sticking.
Keep the skin on for easier handling.

recipes.title: Spiced Cabbage and Potato Side
recipes.summary: A dry-spiced cabbage and potato stir-fry with mustard seeds and turmeric.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the mustard and cumin seeds for 30 seconds until they pop.
Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes until soft, then add the potato, turmeric, ground coriander and salt and cook for 8 minutes, stirring, until the potato starts to soften.
Add the cabbage and water, cover and cook for 8 minutes until both are tender.
Scatter with coriander and serve.
notes: Cut the potato small so it cooks at the same pace as the cabbage.
Add a squeeze of lemon at the end.

recipes.title: Turmeric Rice with Peas and Cashews
recipes.summary: Fluffy turmeric rice with peas and toasted cashews, a bright side for curries.
steps: Melt the ghee in a saucepan and fry the cumin seeds for 30 seconds until they sizzle, then add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the rice and turmeric for 1 minute, add the water and salt, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and stir through the cashews.
notes: Rinse the rice first for separate grains.
Do not lift the lid while it cooks.

recipes.title: Smoky Baked Bean Side with Bacon
recipes.summary: Slow-simmered white beans in a smoky tomato sauce with bacon and a little brown sugar.
steps: Cook the bacon and oil in a saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes until crisp, then add the onion and garlic and cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the paprika, tomatoes, sugar and vinegar and simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thick.
Add the beans and salt and simmer gently for 15 minutes until the sauce clings to the beans.
Stir once more until glossy and heated through, then serve hot with grilled meats or on toast.
notes: It thickens as it cools; add a splash of water to loosen.
Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Tangy Pickled Carrots
recipes.summary: Crisp carrot batons in a sweet and tangy vinegar brine, ready to eat the next day.
steps: Pack the carrots into clean jars.
Heat the vinegar, water, sugar, salt, mustard seeds, garlic and peppercorns in a saucepan for 4 minutes until the sugar dissolves and the brine is steaming.
Pour the hot brine over the carrots, cool and refrigerate.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.
Only part of the brine is eaten, so the sodium is an estimate.

recipes.title: Mince and Vegetable Soup with Macaroni
recipes.summary: A family-style soup with beef mince, vegetables and macaroni.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and brown the mince over high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Add the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then add the tomatoes, stock and oregano and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the macaroni and simmer for 8 minutes until tender, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot.
notes: The pasta will absorb liquid on standing, so add water when reheating.
Food safety: cook the mince until no pink remains and at least 75°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Smoky Sausage and Capsicum Soup
recipes.summary: Sausage, capsicum and tomato simmered with smoked paprika and white beans.
steps: Heat the oil in a pot and brown the sausage over medium heat for 6 minutes until golden and cooked.
Add the onion and capsicum and cook for 6 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, stock, beans and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the capsicum is tender and the soup is slightly thick.
Scatter with parsley and serve.
notes: Mash a few beans to thicken the soup.
Food safety: cook sausages until no pink remains and at least 75°C inside; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage and Tortellini Soup
recipes.summary: Italian sausage, spinach and cheese tortellini in a tomato broth.
steps: Heat the oil in a pot and cook the sausage meat over medium-high heat for 7 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 4 minutes until soft, then pour in the tomatoes, stock, oregano and pepper and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the tortellini and cook for 4 minutes until it floats and is tender, then stir in the spinach for 1 minute until wilted.
Ladle into warm bowls and serve hot with crusty bread.
notes: Choose fresh tortellini from the chilled aisle.
Food safety: cook the sausage until no pink remains and at least 75°C inside; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Eggy Bread with Maple Bacon
recipes.summary: Egg-dipped bread fried until golden, served with maple-glazed crispy bacon.
steps: Fry the bacon in a dry pan over medium heat for 5 minutes until crisp, then brush with maple syrup and cook for 1 minute until glossy and set aside.
Whisk the eggs, milk and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Dip the bread into the egg mix until soaked, then fry in the butter for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Serve the eggy bread topped with the bacon.
notes: Use slightly stale bread for the best texture.
Food safety: cook the egg-soaked bread until golden and no wet egg remains; avoid undercooked eggs for young children, pregnant women and older adults.

recipes.title: Spinach and Cheese Breakfast Quesadilla
recipes.summary: Crisp tortilla folded around scrambled egg, wilted spinach and melted cheese.
steps: Wilt the spinach in a hot pan with the oil for 2 minutes until soft, then pour in the eggs and salt and stir for 2 minutes until just set.
Sprinkle half of each tortilla with the cheese, top with the egg and spinach and the tomato, and fold over.
Toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes each side until golden and the cheese has melted.
Cut into wedges and serve.
notes: Press down lightly with a spatula for even browning.
Food safety: cook eggs until set with no liquid egg remaining; avoid undercooked eggs for young children, pregnant women and older adults.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad with Bacon and Sunflower Seeds
recipes.summary: Raw broccoli florets with crispy bacon, sunflower seeds and a tangy yoghurt dressing.
steps: Fry the bacon in a dry pan over medium heat for 6 minutes until crisp, then drain on paper towel.
Toss the broccoli, onion, sunflower seeds and sultanas in a large bowl.
Whisk the yoghurt, mayonnaise, vinegar, honey and salt, pour over the salad and toss to coat.
Top with the bacon and serve cold.
notes: Chop the florets small so every bite has some dressing.
Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Herbed Cauliflower Rice Salad
recipes.summary: Finely chopped cauliflower tossed with herbs, tomato and lemon in a tabbouleh style.
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan and cook the cauliflower for 4 minutes over medium heat until just tender, then cool.
Toss with the tomato, cucumber, parsley, mint and spring onion.
Dress with the lemon juice, remaining oil and salt and toss until combined.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving.
notes: Squeeze the cauliflower in a tea towel after cooking to avoid a watery salad.
Serve with grilled meats or falafel.

recipes.title: Cheesy Garlic Mushrooms Side
recipes.summary: Pan-roasted mushrooms in garlic butter with melted mozzarella and parsley.
steps: Heat the oil and half the butter in a wide pan and cook the mushrooms over high heat for 8 minutes until golden and any liquid has gone.
Add the remaining butter, garlic, salt and pepper and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Scatter with the mozzarella, cover and cook for 2 minutes until melted, then top with parsley and serve.
notes: Do not crowd the pan or the mushrooms will steam instead of browning.
Serve on toast for a quick lunch.

recipes.title: Cabbage Steaks with Garlic Butter
recipes.summary: Thick cabbage slices roasted until caramelised and brushed with garlic butter.

items: 1 small green cabbage (about 800g), cut in 4 thick slices

steps: Heat the oven to 220C. Brush the cabbage with the oil, season with salt and arrange on a tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until the edges are charred and the centres are tender.
Melt the butter with the garlic for 1 minute until fragrant and bubbling, then stir in the lemon juice.
Drizzle the garlic butter over the cabbage and scatter with parsley.
notes: Keep the core in each slice so the layers stay together.
Add chilli flakes for a little heat.
